title: Passkeys
intro: A passkey lets you sign in with your device's screen lock or a security key instead of typing your password. Your password keeps working either way.
remove.label: Remove passkey {name}
unavailable.server: Passkeys are not available on this server's address.
unavailable.browser: This browser cannot create passkeys here. Use your password.

name: Passkey name
name.hint: Helps you recognise it later, for example the device.
currentPassword.hint: Required because you signed in a while ago.
signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again, then add the passkey.
